name: Monclan Weapon Paradox
description:
Sell later: Restorative Shot (when you buy Compress Cooldown), Sprint Boots (when you buy Hollow Point), Extra Health (when you buy Mystic Reverb), Slowing Hex (when you buy Spirit Burn).
Corrupt at the Broker, in order: Hollow Point, Express Shot, Stamina Mastery, Superior Cooldown, Tankbuster.

Generated from aggregate high-rank match stats: items and abilities are scored by usage rate and win rate, then assembled into a buy order.

Created with Claude's help via github.com/GidntSquia/deadlock-optimal-build-finder.
